name: io.github.geezoria/flmcp
title: fLMCP — FL Studio
description: Control FL Studio 2024–2026: transport, mixer, channels, plugins, piano roll, generators.

environmentVariables.name: FLMCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups or presets (all, core, lean, transport, mixer, piano_roll, ...). Default: all.

environmentVariables.name: FLMCP_BRIDGE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder of the FL controller script if auto-detection fails.

environmentVariables.name: FLMCP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for FL Studio per call. Default: 10.
